newsitem.title: USA: All American Comm completes bank facility.
newsitem.headline: All American Comm completes bank facility.

text.p: All American Communications on Tuesday said it has closed a new $155 million four-year syndicated senior credit facility with Chase Manhattan Bank.

The bank syndication replaces the company's $135 million multi-tranche facility and will be used to fund increased television production and for working capital and other general purposes, All American said.
At the same time, All American has issued a notice of redemption for all of its outstanding 6-1/2 percent convertible subordinated notes due 2003.
The approximately $45.8 million outstanding notes will be redeemed at 104.643 plus accrued interest, the company said.
The redemption will be funded from the proceeds of the $100 million senior subordinated note offering completed earlier this month in a 144a private placement.
